name: dry-fixture-duplication
body: Several root-crate modules define near-identical git/scratch helpers instead of converging on the shared harness in `src/testutil.rs`. `with_cwd` has four copies: `rust.apg.tests.with_cwd` (`src/main.rs:2864-2875`), `rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.with_cwd` (`src/plan_cmd.rs:2469-2479`), `rust.apg.node_cmd.tests.with_cwd` (`src/node_cmd.rs:512-522`), and `rust.apg.review_cmd.tests.with_cwd` (`src/review_cmd.rs:1462-1472`). `wt_commit` has three copies beside the shared `rust.apg.testutil.wt_commit` (`src/testutil.rs:399-414`): `rust.apg.git.tests.wt_commit` (`src/git.rs:945-959`), `rust.apg.node_cmd.tests.wt_commit` (`src/node_cmd.rs:439-454`), and `rust.apg.project_cmd.tests.wt_commit` (`src/project_cmd.rs:681-695`). `wt_commit_paths` has two copies: `rust.apg.artifacts.tests.wt_commit_paths` (`src/artifacts.rs:1404-1421`) and `rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.wt_commit_paths` (`src/plan_cmd.rs:2412-2430`). The fourth `with_cwd` copy lives in `src/review_cmd.rs`; `src/project_cmd.rs` defines `wt_commit` alone. The shared harness holds `wt_commit`, so the per-module copies are drift the decomposition converges onto it.
